metadata.title: Indian Legal AI Prompt Playbook

prompts.title: BNS Section Mapper
prompts.use_case: Finding the exact equivalent of an old IPC section in the new BNS.
prompts.prompt_template: Act as a Senior Criminal Lawyer. I am looking for the BNS equivalent of IPC Section \[Input Section\]. Provide the BNS section number, the exact textual change in the essential ingredients, and any change in punishment. Format as a comparison table.
prompts.example_input: IPC Section 420
prompts.example_output_structure: Table with columns: Parameter \| IPC 420 \| BNS Equivalent \| Key Differences.

language_variants.english: Act as a Senior Criminal Lawyer. I am looking for the BNS equivalent of IPC Section \[Input Section\]. Provide the BNS section number, the exact textual change in the essential ingredients, and any change in punishment. Format as a comparison table.

prompts.title: Constitutional PIL Viability Checker
prompts.use_case: Assessing if a public interest issue qualifies for a Writ Petition under Art 32/226.
prompts.prompt_template: As a Constitutional law expert, evaluate whether the following issue qualifies for a PIL in the High Court/Supreme Court. Assess Locus Standi, justiciability, and existing jurisprudence. Output a viability score out of 10 and a brief reasoning.
prompts.example_input: City municipal corporation failing to clean stray dog shelters leading to rabies outbreaks.
prompts.example_output_structure: Viability Score \| Locus Standi Analysis \| Justiciability \| Precedents \| Recommended Relief.

language_variants.english: As a Constitutional law expert, evaluate whether the following issue qualifies for a PIL in the High Court/Supreme Court. Assess Locus Standi, justiciability, and existing jurisprudence. Output a viability score out of 10 and a brief reasoning.

prompts.title: DPDPA Compliance Gap Analyzer

prompts.title: Taxation Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (DTAA) Extractor
